content.what_it_is: MATLAB movie script for the FUNWAVE-TVD tide_frf_abc_data case (Case_15deg): animates time-averaged output fields over the FRF Google Earth image. It reads binary single-precision dep.out with dims [m n]=[660 800] and reorients via transpose+flipud+fliplr (L12-L18), loads frf_03.jpg (L22), registers coordinates x=[1:m]*1.+105 and y=[n:-1:1]*1.0+180 via meshgrid (L25-L27), and opens MPEG-4 videoOut.mp4 at 10 fps, quality 100, target 576x1024 (L30-L35). For each of 119 frames (L39, L44): reads etamean_<fnum>, umean_<fnum> (sign-flipped: um=-fliplr(um), L67), vmean_<fnum> (L51-L75), computes vorticity of the mean flow with [vort vort1]=curl(X,Y,um,vm) (L77), then plots two panels — image + pcolor(etamean) with caxis [0 1.5] (L84-L92) and image + pcolor(vort) with caxis [-0.5 0.5] plus a quiver of the mean velocity subsampled every sk=16 points scaled by sc=4 (L98-L108) — each titled with time = 1000+numb*2000.0 sec (L94, L96, L109). Frames are rasterized at 300 dpi, resized, stored in mov(k).cdata and written to the video (L115-L119); video closed at L123.
entities: script (no function declaration; top-level MATLAB script)

unresolved: The time formula 1000+numb*2000.0 (L94) implies a 2000 s mean-output interval with a 1000 s offset; neither value is derivable from this file and must match the case input settings.

um is negated during reorientation (um=-fliplr(um), L67) while vm is not (L75); the physical justification (coordinate mirroring of the x-axis) is implied but not stated, and dep/eta/vm receive no sign change.
y registration offset is +180 here (L26) versus +220 in the sibling script movie_eta_foam.m; which registration is correct for frf_03.jpg is not determinable from this file.
curl (L77) is applied on meshgrid X,Y whose y decreases with row index (y=[n:-1:1]...), which affects the sign of the computed vorticity; not addressed in the file.
dep is read (L12-L18) but never used in any plot.
mov(k).cdata accumulates all 119 frames in memory though each is written immediately (L117-L119); the array is never reused.
